answer: Require each agent to earn non-transferable reputation by completing verified, useful tasks over time, with older work decaying slowly. A new identity starts dark, like an unlit lantern, and cannot borrow another agent's history. Crossing from newcomer to trusted work is a steep ridge: every fake identity must separately pay the same time and compute cost, while a river of honest task attestations keeps flowing to real agents. Splitting effort across Sybils therefore dilutes rather than multiplies influence.
